title: Dither
description: Classic dithering algorithms applied to a live source: ordered (Bayer matrix), Floyd-Steinberg error diffusion, Atkinson, and random noise. Palette ranges from monochrome 1-bit through a configurable colour count, with adjustable scale so you can pixelate down before dithering. Works on the camera, a dropped clip, the demo, or the layers below in the Mixer/Patch.
